'''''Vriesea carinata''''' is a plant [[species]] in the genus ''[[Vriesea]]''.

The [[bromeliad]] is [[endemic]] to the [[Atlantic Forest|Atlantic Forest biome]] (''Mata Atlantica Brasileira''), located in southeastern [[Brazil]].
